Download the package for your platform:

- **Windows x64:** `windows-x64-setup.exe` installer or `windows-x64-portable.zip`. Extract the portable ZIP to a writable folder and keep `portable.json` beside the executable.
- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `macos-arm64.dmg`.
- **macOS Intel:** `macos-x64.dmg`.

Windows requires WebView2. macOS builds are not notarized; use the macOS Privacy & Security controls to allow the app if Gatekeeper blocks it. Windows may show a SmartScreen publisher warning.

The `.sig`, `.app.tar.gz` and `latest.json` files support automatic updates. Updater packages are verified against the app's public key before publication. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists download checksums. Updater signatures are separate from Apple notarization or Windows publisher signing.

English is the default interface language; ten languages are available in Settings. See the [README](https://github.com/coolbirdzik/inzoi-better-mod-manager#readme) for supported mod formats, setup, downloads and data recovery.
